Markets.title: US stocks: US market ends down sharply; worries about AI trade and high oil prices weigh
Markets.summary: U.S. stocks fell sharply on Friday, driven by renewed selling of AI-related technology shares. Rising oil prices also contributed to market declines by fueling concerns over economic stability and borrowing costs.

Markets.title: Big US bank stocks head for longest weekly losing streak since 2008
Markets.summary: Major US bank stocks are experiencing their longest weekly losing streak since the 2008 financial crisis. This downturn is driven by mixed quarterly earnings, rising inflation, and concerns about artificial intelligence disrupting the financial sector.

Markets.title: Chip selloff deepens Wall Street losses as doubts grew over AI returns
Markets.summary: US stocks and semiconductor shares fell as investors doubted whether massive investments in artificial intelligence infrastructure will generate profits. The Nasdaq 100 dropped 1.8%, marking its longest losing streak since 2008.

Markets.title: CoreWeave stock wipeout exposes divide between AI fear and greed
Markets.summary: CoreWeave is facing stock volatility and default fears driven by rising bond yields and heavy debt, despite strong demand for artificial intelligence. While optimistic remarks from Nvidia's CEO provided temporary relief, investor sentiment toward the company remains cautious.

Markets.title: Crompton Greaves Consumer Electricals Ltd Q2 Results: Profit surges 65% to Rs 124 crore
Markets.summary: Crompton Greaves Consumer Electricals reported a 65 percent increase in consolidated net profit to Rs 124 crore for the September quarter. Revenue from operations jumped 18.15 percent, driven by strong growth in the electric consumer durable segment.

Markets.title: Cult.fit receives Sebi approval for proposed IPO
Markets.summary: Fitness platform Cult.fit has received regulatory approval from Sebi for its proposed initial public offering, which includes a fresh issue of up to Rs 950 crore alongside an offer for sale. The company reported a 36.26% increase in revenue for FY26, driven by nationwide expansion and improved adjusted EBITDA margins.

Geo-Political.title: Inside Ukrainian offensive pushing Russia back - with Starlink playing a key role
Geo-Political.summary: BBC reporters accompanied Ukraine's Operation Vivaldi as forces reclaimed territory in the Donbas using Starlink technology. However, this military progress is tempered by growing political tensions with President Trump.

Geo-Political.title: Oregon teacher fought school attacker before armed dad shot suspect 'multiple times'
Geo-Political.summary: An armed father shot a 16-year-old suspect multiple times after an Oregon teacher intervened during an attack at a primary school. The former student had targeted a special educational needs classroom.

Geo-Political.title: Palestinians and US journalist injured by Israeli settlers in West Bank harvest attack
Geo-Political.summary: Masked Israeli settlers attacked Palestinians attempting to harvest olives in the West Bank. The assault resulted in injuries to both the Palestinians and a US journalist.

Geo-Political.title: Katie Zacharia leaving her White House role less than five days on the job
Geo-Political.summary: Katie Zacharia is leaving her position as White House press secretary after less than five days on the job. Her departure follows heavy media criticism regarding her credentials and preparedness during her public debut on Tuesday.

Geo-Political.title: Trump 'completely wrong' to restrict support for Ukraine, Italian minister tells BBC
Geo-Political.summary: Italian Defence Minister Guido Crosetto told the BBC that Donald Trump is entirely wrong to restrict support for Ukraine. Crosetto warned that US restrictions risk prolonging Russia's invasion rather than helping to end it.

Geo-Political.title: Trial of German steakhouse heiress that sparked a huge spy scandal
Geo-Political.summary: A Hamburg court is trying German steakhouse heiress Christina Block on charges that she ordered the abduction of her children. The ongoing trial has sparked a major spy scandal over the alleged kidnapping plot.

Data & Insights.title: PM-SETU: Five ITI clusters to get  ₹1,195 crore investment from Tata Steel Foundation, BVG India, others
Data & Insights.summary: Tata Steel Foundation, BVG India, and three other companies will invest to upgrade five ITI clusters under the PM-SETU scheme. This brings the cumulative approved investment under the scheme to ₹3,687 crore.

Data & Insights.title: Vibrant Goa summit to connect 220 Goan MSMEs with 300+ global buyers – What to expect?
Data & Insights.summary: The Government of Goa is hosting a three-day business summit from October 29 to 31 at the Dr Shyama Prasad Mukherjee Indoor Stadium. The event will connect 220 local MSMEs with over 300 global buyers and business leaders from more than 50 countries.

Data & Insights.title: ‘Most consequential change’: Kevin Warsh says AI will reshape US economy, warns of a ‘bumpy’ road ahead
Data & Insights.summary: Federal Reserve Chair Kevin Warsh stated that artificial intelligence will boost productivity over time while potentially raising inflation in the short term. He also warned that economic uncertainty and emerging markets could make the technological transition difficult.

Data & Insights.title: India may hike fuel prices in November, pushing inflation above RBI target: Oxford Economist
Data & Insights.summary: Oxford Economics reports that India may moderately raise fuel prices in November ahead of early next year's state elections. This potential price hike is expected to push inflation above the Reserve Bank of India's target.

Data & Insights.title: Put private sector at center of development agenda: Sitharaman to World Bank
Data & Insights.summary: Finance Minister Sitharaman urged the World Bank to place the private sector at the center of its development agenda by prioritizing job creation and productivity. She also called for the multilateral lender to provide competitive pricing and local currency financing tools.

India.title: Man Arrested For Killing Associate Over Rs 10,000 Debt In Uttarakhand
India.summary: Sunil Kumar was arrested in Uttarakhand for allegedly killing his associate, Sumit Kumar, with a bamboo stick. The fatal attack followed a dispute over an unpaid debt of 10,000 rupees.

India.title: Probe Agency ED Summons Pinarayi Vijayan In Money Laundering Case
India.summary: The Enforcement Directorate has summoned Kerala Chief Minister Pinarayi Vijayan in a money laundering case. This follows two FIRs registered by the state's Vigilance and Anti-Corruption Bureau against Vijayan and his family regarding the alleged CMRL bribery case.

India.title: Tremors, Tectonic Shifts: Milind Deora, Shashi Tharoor's Banter Over Protests
India.summary: Politicians Milind Deora and Shashi Tharoor engaged in social media banter regarding recent protests. Their online exchange began after Deora posted a comment mentioning an earthquake in Panama.

India.title: Sankoo Becomes Ladakh's 8th District, Gets Separate Hill Council
India.summary: Sankoo has been established as Ladakh's eighth district along with a separate hill council. This change follows local demands, even though Sankoo was excluded from the initial five new districts announced earlier this year.

India.title: 3 Detained After Missing J&K Special Officer's Body Found With Head Injuries
India.summary: Three people have been detained following the discovery of missing Jammu and Kashmir Special Police Officer Bashir Ahmad near his home. Ahmad's body bore visible head injuries a day after he went missing on Thursday morning.

India.title: Tibetan Government-in-Exile Tells World: Prepare Now for Dalai Lama's Succession
India.summary: The Tibetan Government-in-Exile has urged the international community to prepare for the succession of the Dalai Lama. The process of recognizing his successor remains a sensitive dispute between the exiles and Beijing.

General.summary: An armed father shot a 16-year-old former student multiple times after an Oregon teacher fought off the suspect during an attack on a special educational needs classroom. Police stated that the suspect had previously attended the primary school.

General.title: Watch: Will Ukraine get the support needed as tensions with US rise?
General.summary: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky expressed gratitude to key supporters ahead of his meeting with the European Union in Brussels. This development comes amid rising tensions regarding the level of support Ukraine will receive from the United States.

General.title: Man killed by tiger may have had medical records breached by NHS staff
General.summary: Twenty-four-year-old William Chapman was mauled to death by a tiger at Yorkshire Wildlife Park on Saturday. NHS staff may have subsequently breached his medical records.
